tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Dimension reduction for ancient kappa-solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0077 ↗ thm:chow-iii-point-picking-infinite-ascr ↗ thm:chow-iii-dimension-reduction-two 1. ch18:18.21\group Dimension Reduction

A noncompact ancient $\kappa $-solution with $\operatorname {ASCR}(t)=\infty $ dimension reduces to the product of a bounded nonnegatively curved $(n-1)$-dimensional $\kappa $-solution and a line.
Proof

\sketch Theorem 2 provides the required centers and scales. Noncollapsing supplies the injectivity-radius estimate, so Theorem 2 applies. Noncollapsing passes to smooth pointed limits and to the product factor.

□
